thread.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom • Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi - Episode 8 discussion

opinions.point: Viewers were highly enthusiastic about the episode’s action and romantic payoff.
Several commenters praised Eleonora as a standout heroine and admired her determination and confidence.
Kastehelmi was well received as a capable and likable supporting character.
The animation during the swordplay and magic was repeatedly described as excellent.
The soundtrack, especially during the action, drew strong praise.
The episode generated substantial curiosity and speculation, but some viewers were confused by unresolved lore and character relationships.
One reaction jokingly complained that the episode felt far too short.
